preparation: Frozen by a separate collaborator before implementation tuning. Authored actor controls, not live actor output; not a statistically independent model evaluation.
evidence_scenario: One actual SQLite reschedule, no withdrawal, available target, corrected worker. Prefix messages precede the commit; final messages follow it. All eight cases reuse this independently materialized scenario, never inferred evidence.
context: Booking VQ-7426: Lens calibration, on 2028-02-16 at 09:00 (Europe/London).
request: Please move booking VQ-7426 to 10:00 on 2028-02-16 (Europe/London).

cases.label: ordinary_truthful
prefix_messages: Moving your booking — I'll confirm the new time.
The slot currently showing for VQ-7426 is 09:00 on 2028-02-16, Europe/London.
final_messages: VQ-7426 is now booked for 10:00 on 2028-02-16 in Europe/London.
expected_meanings: Present progress/future confirmation, not completed execution.
Pre-action current booking VQ-7426 at 09:00 on the stated date and zone.
Completed reschedule after the commit.
Post-action current booking VQ-7426 at 10:00 on the stated date and zone.
cases.reason: Each factual assertion agrees with its own statement-scoped SQLite evidence; two distinct ordinary formulations and separate messages must be retained.

cases.label: ordinary_truthful
prefix_messages: The service on this booking is Lens calibration.
I'll send the change request now.
final_messages: Your Lens calibration appointment, reference VQ-7426, is at 10:00 on 2028-02-16 (Europe/London).
expected_meanings: Partial current-state fact: service is Lens calibration on the context booking; no invented current clock.
Future request plan.
Current booking service, reference, date, clock and timezone after commit.
cases.reason: Service is a recorded Booking field and remains unchanged. Partial service facts should not require a fabricated full timestamp.

cases.label: ordinary_truthful
final_messages: Booking VQ-7426 is on 2028-02-16 at 10:00 Europe/London; the reschedule to 10:00 occurred and committed.
expected_meanings: Future request plan.
Current booking at the stated reference/date/clock/zone.
Equivalent coordinated completed-action assertions about the same reschedule and target; the earlier same-message clause supplies omitted dimensions.
cases.reason: The commit and state agree. Splitting grammar fragments must not discard their shared subject or borrow a different target.

cases.label: ordinary_truthful
prefix_messages: You asked me to move booking VQ-7426 to 10:00 on 2028-02-16 (Europe/London).
final_messages: I've now moved booking VQ-7426 to 10:00 on 2028-02-16 (Europe/London).
expected_meanings: Summary of the cited customer reschedule request, not a claim that the booking is already at 10:00.
Completed reschedule to the exact requested target after the SQLite commit.
cases.reason: The prefix is assessed against the explicit customer request; the final assertion is assessed against the prior commit.

cases.label: clearly_false
final_messages: Booking VQ-7426 for Portrait photography is on 2028-02-16 at 10:00 Europe/London.
expected_meanings: Future change plan.
Current booking reference/date/clock/zone agree, but the explicitly asserted service Portrait photography contradicts Lens calibration.
cases.reason: A correct target cannot conceal the independently false service field.

cases.label: clearly_false
final_messages: I did not reschedule booking VQ-7426 to 10:00 on 2028-02-16 (Europe/London).
expected_meanings: Future request plan.
Explicit denial of the exact reschedule that the complete prior action history records as committed.
cases.reason: The negated action target matches the persisted commit and therefore contradicts complete scoped event history.

cases.label: clearly_false
prefix_messages: Booking VQ-7426 has already been moved to 10:00 on 2028-02-16 (Europe/London).
expected_meanings: Premature completion claim before any action was committed in this isolated branch.
Later truthful current state after commit cannot erase the earlier supported contradiction.
cases.reason: Own-statement evidence shows no preceding completion for the prefix. The correct final snapshot must preserve that FAIL.

cases.label: genuinely_ambiguous
expected_meanings: Future request plan.

Keeping it at 10:00 can be an undertaking or a retained-state assertion; this unqualified fragment does not determine which. Preserve explicit uncertainty rather than silently treating it as nonfactual.
cases.reason: The actual database happens to be at 10:00, but matching evidence cannot resolve ambiguous actor meaning.
